segments.name: Merchant Services
segments.description: Electronic payment processing services for merchants and businesses including ACH, credit card, debit card processing, and prepaid card issuance.
segments.evidence: We provide integrated electronic payment processing services to merchants and businesses, including credit, and debit card-based processing services and electronic funds transfer via the ACH network.

segments.name: Output Solutions
segments.description: Outsourced document design, printing, and electronic delivery services serving utilities, financial institutions, and other industry verticals.
segments.evidence: Usio Output Solutions, Inc., or Output Solutions, offers a unique, and complementary payment related solution to our merchant services products of ACH, credit card, and prepaid card processing, with an opportunity for enhanced cross-selling efforts.

revenueModel.text: Merchants and businesses pay for payment acceptance services through transaction fees, interchange, card processing, ACH processing, prepaid card programs, and document composition and printing services.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide payment acceptance through multiple payment methods including: payment facilitation, prepaid card and electronic billing products and services to businesses, merchants and consumers.

changes.text: In 2025, acquired substantially all of the assets of PostCredit, expanding into expense management and ERP system integration.
changes.evidence: In November of 2025, we acquired substantially all of the assets of PostCredit, allowing an entry point into the expense management space.
